summary: Build a professional B2B lead-generation website for PropertyOps® (U.S.-based property operations firm) with operational, credibility-focused positioning (including E-2 visa/immigration authority credibility), emphasizing standardized workflows, documented delivery, contractor-native model, and a future franchise teaser; clean modern design with neutral palette and process/diagram visuals (no flashy tech/AI imagery).
architectural_notes: Homepage must include explicit Technology & Systems positioning: technology supports operations and does not replace people; emphasize U.S.-based operations team and documented workflows.
Services section must list exactly three core services: Rental Turnover Condition Reports; Minor Turnover Repairs & Punch Lists; Exterior Maintenance Packages.

existing_features.title: Create a single-page marketing website homepage for PropertyOps® with the exact section structure and user-facing copy direction provided: Hero (headline, subheadline, CTA), How It Works (3 steps), Technology & Systems (ops-supporting tech, explicitly not replacing people), Services (exactly three services), Quality Control, Contractor Model, Trust/Differentiators callouts, and Franchise Teaser.

Implement a lead-capture workflow for the “Request a Service Consultation” CTA that opens a consultation request form (embedded section or modal) and submits the request to the backend for storage, with a clear success state and basic client-side validation.

Apply a cohesive visual theme that matches the provided design direction: clean, modern, professional; neutral palette (dark blue, slate, white) with subtle green accents; use icons for SOPs/checklists/documentation/QC and process/flow visuals; avoid robots, “AI brain” imagery, and flashy/futuristic visuals.

Add SEO fundamentals for a B2B services homepage: page title, meta description, semantic headings, and on-page keyword placement emphasizing the provided SEO keywords, while keeping the tone calm and operational (no hype/buzzwords).

Include credibility-forward, compliance-friendly messaging consistent with the brief (U.S.-based operations team, documented delivery, standardized processes) suitable for investors, franchise prospects, and immigration authorities, without adding legal claims or guarantees.

Render generated brand visuals (icons/diagram/hero graphic) as static frontend assets and use them in the appropriate sections (hero, how-it-works, quality control, trust callouts), without routing image delivery through the backend.
